name: Navidrome
description: Navidrome is a lightweight open-source music server and streamer compatible with Subsonic and OpenSubsonic clients.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent Navidrome database, configuration, playlists and cache. The container UID/GID must have read/write access to this directory.

paths.name: Music
paths.description: Music library. Read-only is recommended. Change this host path to match the location of your music library.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Navidrome web interface and Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level: error, warn, info, debug or trace.

variables.name: Scan Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule for automatic library scans. 0 disables scheduled scans; filesystem watching and startup scanning remain controlled separately.

variables.name: Session Timeout
variables.description: Maximum idle time before a Web UI session is closed.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Optional URL path prefix when serving Navidrome from a subpath, for example /music. Leave empty when using a dedicated hostname.

variables.name: Image Cache Size
variables.description: Maximum size of the artwork image cache. Set to 0 to disable the image cache.

variables.name: Share URL
variables.description: Optional public base URL used for shared links, for example https://music.example.com. Leave empty to use the current server address.
